abstract: Malignancy, including testicular tumors, significantly increases the risk of venous thromboembolism (VTE). In this study, we search for predictors that may help identify subgroups of patients at higher risk of VTE. Patients with confirmed diagnosis of testicular germ cell tumor and proven VTE were identified. Clinical and pathological features possibly associated with VTE were reviewed. A total of 322 patients, median age (range) 31 (18-76) years were identified. Tumors were mostly non-seminoma (n = 194, 60.2%), node-positive (n = 130, 40.4%) and 58 (18.0%) had metastatic disease at diagnosis. Venous thromboembolism were confirmed in 27 (8.4%) patients; however, rates were significantly higher (P < 0.001) in patients with node-positive (18.5%), metastatic disease (22.4%), and those with high lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) (21.3%). Rates were also significantly higher among those who received multiple lines of chemotherapy (27.5%) compared to those who received one line (13.8%) or none (<1.0%), P < 0.001. Patients with testicular tumors and high tumor burden, including nodal involvement, high LDH or metastatic disease, and those treated with multiple lines of chemotherapy have significantly higher rates of VTE.
abstract_ja: 悪性腫瘍は、精巣腫瘍を含め、静脈血栓塞栓症(VTE)のリスクを著しく高める。本研究では、VTEのリスクが高い患者のサブグループを特定するのに役立つ予測因子を探索する。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の確定診断を受け、VTEが証明された患者を同定した。VTEに関連する可能性のある臨床的および病理学的特徴を検討した。322例（年齢中央値(範囲)31歳(18～76歳)）が同定された。腫瘍は主に非セミノーマ(n = 194、60.2%)、リンパ節陽性(n = 130、40.4%)であり、58例(18.0%)は診断時に転移性疾患を有していた。VTEは27例(8.4%)で確認されたが、リンパ節陽性(18.5%)、転移性疾患(22.4%)、高乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)値(21.3%)の患者では発生率が有意に高かった(P < 0.001)。複数ラインの化学療法を受けた患者では発生率がさらに高く(27.5%)、1ライン(13.8%)または化学療法なし(<1.0%)の患者と比較して有意であった(P < 0.001)。結節浸潤、高LDH値、または転移性疾患を含む高い腫瘍量を有し、複数ラインの化学療法を受けた精巣腫瘍患者は、VTEの発生率が有意に高い。
